narr: Diurnal convection over Central Alabama during the afternoons of June 16 and 17 led to several instances of wind damage. One storm in particular caused fairly widespread tree damage across Anniston, Oxford, and Weaver in Calhoun County, with some trees falling on homes, vehicles, or power lines. More afternoon thunderstorms lingered over the Birmingham metro on June 18, causing minor flooding of several area roadways around downtown Birmingham, Homewood, and Irondale.
ev: Numerous roadways were flooded around downtown Birmingham, Homewood, and Irondale. An underpass at the I-20/I-459 interchange was flooded, U.S. 31 at Ventura Ave in Homewood was flooded, and Floyd Bradford Rd was flooded at Amber Hills Rd. In addition, there were several reports of flooding in the I-59/20 area south of Birmingham-Shuttlesworth Airport, including 31st St and Tallapoosa St.
